shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files | rg '("'^|/)(.*test.*|'"\\.lore/dod\\.md|\\.lore/test-commands\\.yml|package\\.json)"'$'"' | head -120 && printf '\\n--- commands ---\\n' && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- dod ---\\n' && cat .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,210p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,210p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && cat package.json && cat jest.config.js && rg -n 'specs/|spec anchor|@spec|anchor' src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -50"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'onError|error.*same|toBe\\(error' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && git status --short && git branch --show-current && git remote -v && git log -1 --oneline"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '@spec|spec-anchor|spec:' src scripts | head -40 && sed -n '1,120p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && ls .lore"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.+#[0-9]|@spec|specAnchor|spec anchor|spec=' .lore scripts src | head -80 && ls scripts/spec-links"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'tail -8 specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/nonErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts | head -70 && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'cat .lore/dod.md && git diff -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/nonErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/nonErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "Add acceptance test for non-Error rejections" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md && git add .lore/dod.md && git commit --amend --no-edit && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} && git log -1 --oneline'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push --force-with-lease origin HEAD && git status -sb && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} && git log -1 --oneline'
